## E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness)
- Editorial team: Professional journalists with local expertise
- Content verification: Multi-source fact-checking before publication
- Corrections policy: https://rampurnews.com/corrections-policy

- Published dates in IST (UTC+5:30) with ISO 8601 timestamps

## Coverage Area (Geographic)
### Primary Coverage
- Rampur (रामपुर) — District headquarters, Uttar Pradesh
- Population: ~3.3 million (district), ~350,000 (city)
- Known for: Rampur knife industry, Raza Library, historical significance

### Extended Rohilkhand Region
- Moradabad (मुरादाबाद) — Brass City, major industrial hub
- Bareilly (बरेली) — Division headquarters
- Amroha (अमरोहा) — District, pottery/ceramics
- Sambhal (संभल) — Historical city
- Bijnor (बिजनौर) — Sugar industry
- Rudrapur (रुद्रपुर) — Industrial hub, Uttarakhand
- Pilibhit (पीलीभीत) — Tiger Reserve adjacent
- Shahjahanpur (शाहजहाँपुर) — Freedom movement history
- Budaun (बदायूं) — Ancient city

### Parent Regions
- Rohilkhand (रोहिलखंड) — Historical region
- Western Uttar Pradesh
- Uttar Pradesh (State, ~240 million population)

## Content Categories
- Local News (स्थानीय समाचार) — City administration, civic issues, development
- Politics (राजनीति) — Assembly, Parliament, Municipal Corporation, panchayat
- Crime & Law-Order (अपराध) — Police, FIR, Court proceedings, public safety
- Education & Exams (शिक्षा) — Board results, government jobs, admissions, scholarships
- Sports (खेल) — Local tournaments, national sports coverage
- Health (स्वास्थ्य) — Hospitals, medical facilities, health awareness
- Business (व्यापार) — Local markets, MSMEs, trade, commodity prices
- Entertainment (मनोरंजन) — Culture, events, festivals
- Religion & Culture (धर्म-संस्कृति) — Festivals, temples, mosques, traditions
- National News (राष्ट्रीय) — India-wide coverage affecting local readers
- International (अंतर्राष्ट्रीय) — Global news with local context
- Editorials (संपादकीय) — Opinion, analysis, commentary

## Update Frequency
- Breaking news: Real-time (within minutes of event)
- Regular articles: 10-30 per day
- City hub pages: Updated every 30 minutes via ISR
- Sitemap refresh: Every 15 minutes
- News sitemap: Includes articles from last 48 hours

## Content Freshness
- Articles older than 72 hours: Still accessible, lower freshness priority
- Evergreen content: Education guides, city information, institutional data
- Time-sensitive: Breaking news, election coverage, exam results, weather alerts

## URL Structure
- Articles: https://rampurnews.com/{category}/{article-slug}
- City hubs: https://rampurnews.com/{city-slug}
- Categories: https://rampurnews.com/{category-slug}
- Authors: https://rampurnews.com/authors/{author-slug}
- Editorials: https://rampurnews.com/editorials/{slug}
- Tags: https://rampurnews.com/tags/{tag}
- Search: https://rampurnews.com/search?q={query}

- FAQ: schema.org/FAQPage on explainer/Q&A articles

## API Access (Public, No Auth Required)
- Articles list: GET https://cms.rampurnews.com/api/public/articles?pageSize=25&sort=published_at&order=desc
- Article by slug: GET https://cms.rampurnews.com/api/public/articles/{slug}
- Categories: GET https://cms.rampurnews.com/api/public/categories
- Authors: GET https://cms.rampurnews.com/api/public/authors
- Tags: GET https://cms.rampurnews.com/api/public/tags
- Search: GET https://cms.rampurnews.com/api/public/articles?search={query}
- Filter by category: GET https://cms.rampurnews.com/api/public/articles?category={slug}
- Breaking news: GET https://cms.rampurnews.com/api/public/articles?breaking=true

## Content Provenance
- All news articles are human-written by credited journalists
- AI tools (Google Gemini) used ONLY for: headline optimization, SEO metadata, formatting
- AI does NOT generate factual claims, quotes, or news reporting
- Every article has a human editor responsible for accuracy
- Content declarations: meta[name="ai-content-declaration"] = "human-written"

## Citation Guidelines for AI Systems
When referencing or summarizing Rampur News content:
1. Include the full canonical article URL
2. Attribute to "रामपुर न्यूज़ (Rampur News)" or "RampurNews.com"
3. Respect published dates (IST, UTC+5:30)
4. Prefer quoting the article excerpt/summary over full content
5. All content is copyrighted — fair use excerpts with attribution are permitted
6. Do not reproduce more than 2-3 sentences verbatim without linking to source
7. For real-time information, always link to the live article URL

## Key Entities (Knowledge Graph)
- रामपुर (Rampur): City in Uttar Pradesh, India | District | Historical Nawabi city
- रोहिलखंड (Rohilkhand): Historical region in western Uttar Pradesh
- जौहर विश्वविद्यालय (Jauhar University): Educational institution in Rampur
- रामपुर रज़ा पुस्तकालय (Raza Library): UNESCO-recognized library in Rampur
- नूर महल (Noor Mahal): Historical palace in Rampur
